description: Election Commission - Mr. R. M. L. R. Ranaraja of the Harispattuwa P/S was vacated his office of the member
reasoning: This gazette notice is a declaration by a Returning Officer that a member of a local authority (Harispattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and the administration of local government elections, specifically addressing the vacation of office by an elected member, which is covered by Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
